{{CharInfobox |color={{cute color}} |corecolor={{cute color light}} |bordercolor={{cute color dark}} |name=Nina |jname=ノア |tmname=Noa |text=white |image=Nina.png |size=250px |caption=Nina |age=no |gender=Female |colors=yes |eyes=Mauve |hair=Wine |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Alola]] |relatives=Unnamed husband |trainer=no |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=SM013 |epname=Racing to a Big Event! |java=[[Ami Koshimizu]] |enva=[[List of English voice actors|Jessie Kane Gill]] }} '''Nina''' (Japanese: '''ノア''' ''Noa'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}. She is a noted restaurant waitress at a [[Hau'oli City]] pancake parlor. She is also a previous winner of the annual [[Pokémon Pancake Race]]. ==History== [[File:Nina and Husband.png|250px|thumb|left|Nina and her husband]] Nina debuted in ''[[SM013|Racing to a Big Event!]]'' after {{an|Professor Kukui}} and {{Ash}} decided to stop for a quick bite at her restaurant. She recommended that Ash enter the upcoming [[Pokémon Pancake Race]], even explaining the rules and helping Ash and {{AP|Pikachu}} train for the event. The next day, Nina and her {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Raichu}} entered the Pokémon Pancake Race. During the final section of the race, Raichu ran in first place, but due to a distraction caused by {{TRT}} and {{an|Bewear}}, [[Samson Oak]]'s {{p|Komala}} was able to take the lead and win the competition, causing Nina to end up tied with Ash for second place. Although she lost, Nina was content as she had a fun time and told Raichu they would try again next year. In ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]'', Nina attended the wedding of Professor Kukui and {{an|Professor Burnet}} while also providing the event's catering. In ''[[SM072|Sours for the Sweet!]]'', Nina attended [[Aina's Kitchen]] to pick up a lunch order. [[Ulu]] was revealed to have a crush on her. However, she informed him that she had a fiancé during the [[Alola Bread Festival]] competition, leaving him heartbroken. She later revealed in ''[[SM102|Alola, Alola!]]'' that she had married her fiancé. In ''[[SM093|Lillier and the Staff!]]'', Nina and her fiancé attended a play at the [[Pokémon School]]. Ash and {{ashcl}} sometimes visit the pancake parlor. On {{an|Misty}}'s [[Alola]]n holiday, they stopped at the restaurant to enjoy Nina's pancake stacks in ''Alola, Alola!''. ==Character== Nina is always upbeat, providing quality customer service alongside her delicious pancake stacks. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} This listing is of Nina's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Nina |pkmn=Raichu |type1=Electric |type2=Psychic |img=Nina Raichu.png |epnum=SM013 |epname=Racing to a Big Event! |vajp= |vaen= |desc=Nina's {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Raichu}} is her only known Pokémon and helps her with her work at the restaurant. Raichu started a rivalry with [[Ash's Pikachu]] when they both competed in the [[Pokémon Pancake Race]]. Raichu was able to make it all the way to the final section of the race, where it was in the lead. However, due to a distraction caused by {{TRT}} and {{an|Bewear}}, [[Samson Oak]]'s {{p|Komala}} was able to pass it. Despite trying its hardest to regain its lead, Raichu tied in second place with Pikachu. It appeared again in ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]'', where it was among those attending the wedding of {{an|Professor Kukui}} and {{an|Professor Burnet}}. It appeared yet again in ''[[SM072|Sours for the Sweet!]]'' It appeared once again in ''[[SM102|Alola, Alola!]]'', where it was shown serving customers.
